runs.text: This is perfect innovation. Israel is here. Fifty-two out of a hundred. Fourteenth of a hundred and thirty-nine countries. What's in the gap? Nobody gets close. Switzerland is first, with sixty-six. And thirteen countries beat Israel. Now zoom out. They say Israel builds nothing. It only destroys. Building nothing looks like this: twelve, the bottom of the list. The Emirates, forty-four. Turkey, thirty-seven. Saudi Arabia, thirty-six. Qatar, thirty-five. Jordan, thirty. Iran, twenty-nine. Egypt, twenty-five. Nobody around us builds more. One honest catch: Switzerland is still fourteen points ahead of us. We're not perfect. We know it. But builds nothing? We're closer to utopia than anyone around us.
